mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that may trigger economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns (positive returns in >55% of cases) or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns (INDPRO annualized growth below 0.5%), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and payroll growth indicates weakening consumer demand and labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns (positive returns in >55% of cases) or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During weak GDP growth (annualized GDPC1 growth below 1.0%), S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 trading days due to recession risks and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth is below 1.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
